title: [review] tx_queue.py:415: confirm_transmitted() doe
description: _remove_first() called by confirm_transmitted() updates stats but never signals entry.reservation.set_result(True). Callers using peek()+confirm_transmitted() pattern with reservations will hang on reservation.wait().
close_reason: Fixed: _remove_first() now signals entry.reservation.set_result(True) before updating stats, ensuring callers using peek()+confirm_transmitted() pattern with reservations do not hang.
